metaInvocations.description: Print the installed CLI package version.
Print a shell completion script generated from the public command specification.

globalOptions.description: Print public CLI help and exit.
Emit machine-readable JSON. pulse dev emits one JSON event per line.
Resolve and report the command plan without executing it.

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Create a conventional .pulse workspace with an async Pulse application and dedicated test harness.

positionals.name: directory
positionals.description: Target directory. Defaults to the current directory.

options.description: Allow generated files to replace entries in a non-empty target directory.
Set the generated npm package name.

outputs: Human output lists generated files and next steps.
With --json, emits one initialization result object.
sideEffects: Creates .pulse/config.ts, an async Pulse application, a dedicated test harness, package scripts, and documentation.
Does not install dependencies or run npm, pnpm, or any network operation.
commands.exit: 0 on success; 2 for invalid usage, provider selection, or unsafe overwrite conditions.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Audit project shape, compilation, schemas, provider bindings, output safety, and required tools.

positionals.name: directory
positionals.description: Project discovery start. Defaults to the current directory.

options.description: Treat doctor warnings as failed checks.
Select a project profile. Precedence: --profile, PULSE_PROFILE, pulse.defaultProfile.

outputs: With --json, emits one completed audit object including failed and warning checks.
sideEffects: Does not write the build output.
commands.exit: 0 when the audit passes; 1 when a completed audit contains failed checks; 2–5 only when the audit command itself cannot be completed.

commands.name: inspect
commands.summary: Report canonical compiler, schema, effect, continuation, capability, provider, and build-mode details.

positionals.name: directory
positionals.description: Project discovery start. Defaults to the current directory.

options.description: Select a project profile. Precedence: --profile, PULSE_PROFILE, pulse.defaultProfile.
Inspect an existing JSON build or compiler artifact instead of a project.

outputs: Human output prints a compact project/compiler summary.
With --json, emits one inspection or artifact object.
sideEffects: Compiles and validates the project in memory.
Does not write the build output.
commands.exit: 0 on success; 2–5 according to the emitted stable diagnostic.

commands.name: test
commands.summary: Run configured cases through the selected provider local-conformance runtime.

positionals.name: directory
positionals.description: Project discovery start. Defaults to the current directory.

options.description: Select a project profile. Precedence: --profile, PULSE_PROFILE, pulse.defaultProfile.
Run one named project test case.

outputs: Human output uses TAP-like case lines and a summary.
With --json, emits one test-run object; expected stable errors remain inside their case results.
sideEffects: Compiles the project and executes configured deterministic or live fixtures.
Does not write the build output.
commands.exit: 0 when all selected cases pass; 1 when the completed test run has failed cases; 2–5 when setup, compilation, runtime, or toolchain execution fails before a normal result.

commands.name: dev
commands.summary: Start the foreground local server with the selected provider conformance runtime.

positionals.name: directory
positionals.description: Project discovery start. Defaults to the current directory.

options.description: Close the development server after the first completed request.
Enable or disable entry and schema dependency watching. Watching is enabled by default.
Select a project profile. Precedence: --profile, PULSE_PROFILE, pulse.defaultProfile.
Override the development listen host.
Override the development listen port. Use 0 to request an ephemeral port.

outputs: Human output reports the ready URL and reload or error messages.
With --json, stdout is newline-delimited JSON events: compiled, ready, reloaded, request, compile-error, and request-error. It is not one enclosing JSON document.
sideEffects: Watches the entry and schema dependency graph by default.
Configuration-file changes require restarting the command.
commands.exit: 0 after a normal server close; 2–5 when setup, compilation, provider, runtime, or toolchain initialization fails.

commands.name: compile
commands.summary: Compile the canonical project into provider-neutral Pulse-owned WebAssembly.

positionals.name: directory
positionals.description: Project discovery start. Defaults to the current directory.

options.description: Remove or preserve the selected output directory before writing artifacts. Cleaning is enabled by default.
Also emit diagnostic WebAssembly text (WAT). Native builds omit it by default; large text emission can exhaust compiler string capacity.
Experimentally optimize Native Wasm with shrink level 2 without convergence. JavaScript build targets reject this flag.
Experimentally optimize Native Wasm for size. JavaScript build targets reject this flag.
Select a project profile. Precedence: --profile, PULSE_PROFILE, pulse.defaultProfile.
Override the project-relative artifact output directory.

outputs: Writes pulse-compile.json, the canonical program, native plan, generated AssemblyScript, compact Wasm, and native manifest; --emit-wat adds diagnostic WAT.
The output is provider-neutral and does not package a deployment provider runtime.
Experimental size builds record the exact non-default Native compiler optimization settings.
With --json, emits one compile result object containing exact artifact paths and native metadata.
sideEffects: Cleans the output directory by default.
Refuses absolute, parent-traversal, and symbolic-link traversal outside the project root.
commands.exit: 0 on success; 2–5 according to the emitted stable diagnostic.

commands.name: build
commands.summary: Compile the canonical project and realize the deployment provider selected by the active project profile.

positionals.name: directory
positionals.description: Project discovery start. Defaults to the current directory.

options.description: Remove or preserve the selected output directory before writing artifacts. Cleaning is enabled by default.
Also emit diagnostic WebAssembly text (WAT). Native builds omit it by default; large text emission can exhaust compiler string capacity.
Experimentally optimize Native Wasm with shrink level 2 without convergence. JavaScript build targets reject this flag.
Experimentally optimize Native Wasm for size. JavaScript build targets reject this flag.
Select a project profile. Precedence: --profile, PULSE_PROFILE, pulse.defaultProfile.
Override the project-relative artifact output directory.

outputs: Writes pulse-build.json, the provider-neutral native module, and the configured provider realization; Native --emit-wat builds also write diagnostic WAT.
Fastly builds write generated AssemblyScript and direct-host-ABI native Wasm at bin/main.wasm; no JavaScript runtime image is packaged.
Experimental size builds record the exact non-default Native compiler optimization settings in portable, provider, and build metadata.
With --json, emits one build result object containing exact portable and provider artifact paths.
sideEffects: Cleans the output directory by default.
Invokes the native compiler and configured provider realization.
Refuses absolute, parent-traversal, and symbolic-link traversal outside the project root.
commands.exit: 0 on success; 2–5 according to the emitted stable diagnostic.
